intro: What actually shipped — not a roadmap. Entries are written by hand in plain language. Older notes may still say Helm; the product is now Trenston.

entries.title: Solo founders: handoffs become Flag for later
entries.description: Company setup asks whether you have people you can actually delegate to (separate from headcount). Solo workspaces get a Flag for later column instead of What to hand off, Onboarding drops Invite your finance team, and insights skip assign-to-teammate drafts.

entries.title: Founder credit in the marketing footer
entries.description: Every marketing page footer now shows Tansher Dhawan, Founder with a LinkedIn link next to the Manila line.

entries.title: Cockpit redesign: shell, Briefing hero, and Ask Trenston
entries.description: The signed-in app gets a clearer command surface. Sidebar Ask Trenston CTA, upgrade/connect promo, and a desktop top bar with search, plan badge, and profile. Briefing opens on a cockpit hero — metric switcher, large figure, period comparison chart, and Assistant / Spending / Decisions columns, with chips that deep-link into Ask. Ask itself is a two-column chat plus context rail (For you / Get started / Get inspired) on large screens.

entries.title: Light and dark theme reliability
entries.description: Light remaps are scoped to data-theme so dark mode works again after the cream marketing refresh. App chrome uses pure white / near-black contrast in light mode, side-by-side KPIs, clearer cards, and a light-blue nav pill. Theme toggle no longer leaves the cockpit stuck in the wrong palette.

entries.title: Briefing readable in dark mode
entries.description: Revenue period charts, gold spend meters, and KPI figures keep contrast on dark Briefing backgrounds. Section separators, Telemetry-style cards, Features filter tabs, and marketing URL/search routing for Briefing deep-links were tightened so the page stays usable after the redesign.

entries.title: Marketing site: navy home, cream auth, Outway footer
entries.description: Home and showcase dividers move to a navy palette with a Contact Us CTA; marketing and auth pages sit on light cream. FAQ type on Pricing and Landing is enlarged to match. Footer is rebuilt in an Outway-style layout with ember accent pop, Instagram, and contact card — plus transparent Trenston favicons for the browser tab.

entries.title: Sales order book, maintenance ops, and procurement settings APIs
entries.description: Sales order-book routes are wired end-to-end with tests. Maintenance ops panels get API indexes and coverage. Procurement settings (monthly budget set/clear) is covered so department ops panels hit real backend contracts instead of silent gaps.

entries.title: Cockpit polish and bugfixes
entries.description: People roster remove works again after Team & Access revoke. Error toasts no longer blank Maintenance and Order book pages. QuickBooks OAuth errors no longer mislabel as Google. ⌘K search lists About and other missing public pages. Ask Trenston sidebar duplicate CTA is gone. Broader audit pass on rate limits, briefing, sync, billing, and UI stability.

entries.title: Helm Control is now Trenston
entries.description: The product formerly called Helm Control is now Trenston at trenston.com. Same cockpit, new name and domain — bookmarks to helmcontrol.online redirect here.

entries.title: Faster tab switching across the cockpit
entries.description: Department pages keep recently loaded data when you switch tabs, so revisiting Briefing, Financials, HR, or Production no longer resets to a loading skeleton every time.

entries.title: Google Calendar and Gmail are personal connections
entries.description: Each teammate connects their own Google account. Meetings and Gmail threads stay on that person’s connection — not a shared workspace mailbox.

entries.title: Public pricing page for crawlers and buyers
entries.description: Standalone /pricing with the live Free, Starter, Growth, and Business tiers, plus structured data and llms.txt so published prices match the product.

entries.title: Public integrations page
entries.description: A marketing page that lists what each connection actually does today — Google, QuickBooks, Xero, SAP Business One, HubSpot, and Slack webhook alerts.

entries.title: SAP Business One in Financials
entries.description: Pull A/R and A/P invoices from SAP Business One Service Layer into the same Financials and Decision Engine pipeline as QuickBooks and Xero.

entries.title: Honest financial zeros vs missing data
entries.description: Burn, MRR, and runway distinguish “not entered” from a confirmed zero, and future-dated ledger rows no longer inflate current metrics.

entries.title: Decision Center ranking and resilience
entries.description: Pending decisions rank by impact within severity, and a single failed AI draft no longer clears the rest of the decision board.

entries.title: Ask Trenston stays inside your access lanes
entries.description: Ask Trenston and department context respect membership and finance:write — no cross-lane leakage of Sales, HR, or financial figures you cannot open in the UI.

entries.title: AI summary freshness labels
entries.description: AI summaries surface when underlying department data may be stale, so leadership can tell synthesis from a live pull.

entries.title: Secure document library
entries.description: Private Cloudflare R2 storage with signed downloads for bills, receipts, and legal files — plus tighter controls on legal document access.

entries.title: Daily alerts and weekly digest email
entries.description: Render cron jobs schedule high-severity alerts and the weekly leadership pack email, separate from in-app Briefing.

entries.title: HR leave cancellation
entries.description: Employees can cancel their own pending leave requests without waiting on an HR lead.

entries.title: Billing clarity after Paddle checkout
entries.description: Plan state refreshes after checkout, seat and AI-extract over-limit usage is shown clearly, and Stripe leftover UI is gone.

entries.title: ⌘K search across settings and site pages
entries.description: Quick search reaches settings sections and public marketing pages from inside the signed-in app.
